C6.shared_fields: truth_removed pairs share the CLAIM byte-identically (only the pool differs); unsupported_claim pairs share the POOLED CHUNK byte-identically (only the claim differs). Both are pair structures the clause names
C6.test: for each pair, look the claim up in the REST of the assembled training mix (685,670 clean rows + the four other loaded lanes, attr_pool excluded) and score the row by the label that association carries. Within-pair accuracy of that oracle is the memorisation channel: on a clean member it is undefined or at chance
